title: Rehoboth Basters arrive
description: Baster families crossing the Orange River found the Free Republic of Rehoboth with its own elected kaptein and constitution.

title: German colony
description: After the trader Adolf Lüderitz buys the bay of Angra Pequena, Bismarck declares a protectorate: German South West Africa.

title: Caprivi Strip
description: The Heligoland-Zanzibar treaty adds the Caprivi panhandle to South West Africa, giving the colony access (in theory) to the Zambezi.

title: Witbooi signs protection treaty
description: After years of guerrilla resistance the Nama chief Hendrik Witbooi is forced to accept German protection.

title: Herero uprising
description: Herero fighters under Samuel Maharero attack German farms and settlements, opening a war that becomes a genocide.

title: Battle of Waterberg
description: German forces under von Trotha break the main Herero army and drive the survivors into the Omaheke desert to die.

title: Extermination order
description: General von Trotha orders the destruction of the Herero people, and Nama under Witbooi and others rise days later; by 1908 most Herero and half the Nama are dead.

title: Diamonds discovered
description: A railway worker finds diamonds in the sand near Lüderitz, setting off a rush and building the diamond towns of the forbidden zone.

title: South Africa occupies the colony
description: The German garrison capitulates after South West African campaign, beginning seventy-five years of South African rule.

title: Mandume killed
description: South African forces kill Mandume ya Ndemufayo, the last Kwanyama king to resist foreign rule.

title: South African mandate
description: The League of Nations gives South Africa a Class C mandate over South West Africa, which South Africa comes to treat as its own.

title: Trusteeship refused
description: South Africa refuses to put the territory under the new UN trusteeship system, opening a forty-year legal battle.

title: Old Location shootings
description: Police shoot into a crowd resisting forced removal to the new township of Katutura, killing about a dozen protesters.

title: ICJ dismisses case
description: The World Court throws out Ethiopia and Liberia's case against South African rule on a technicality, dismaying the territory's supporters.

title: Battle of Omgulumbashe
description: South African helicopters and infantry attack a SWAPO guerrilla camp in the north, the first clash of a liberation war that lasts twenty-three years.

title: General strike
description: Over 13,000 Ovambo contract workers strike against the labour system in the largest mass protest the territory has seen.

title: Cassinga massacre
description: South African paratroops attack a SWAPO camp at Cassinga and kill about six hundred people, many of them refugees.

title: UN Resolution 435
description: The Security Council adopts the Western plan for a ceasefire and UN-supervised elections, the framework of eventual independence.

title: Tripartite Accord
description: South Africa, Cuba and Angola sign accords linking the Cuban withdrawal from Angola to UN-supervised independence for Namibia.

title: UN-supervised elections
description: SWAPO wins 57 percent of the vote in elections judged free and fair by the United Nations.

title: Independence
description: Sam Nujoma is sworn in as president of independent Namibia, Africa's last colony on the mainland to be free.

title: Walvis Bay reintegrated
description: South Africa hands back its last enclave, the deep-water port of Walvis Bay with the Penguin Islands.

title: Caprivi attack
description: Caprivi Liberation Army separatists attack Katima Mulilo and are crushed, ending the only armed challenge to the new state.

title: General election
description: President Hage Geingob wins a second term but SWAPO loses its two-thirds majority for the first time.
